witness.explanation: The filter tested only two of four gain-positive residual shapes. In particular, a four-suffix with one qubit outside the target logical support can still give a positive gain after cancellation by a singleton. Requiring each hook to fit entirely inside the target support misses such configurations.
witness.evidence: The same candidate admits target support V={1,3,7,11,12,14,72,73,74,77,78,80}. Use check 66's four-suffix {78,12,141,72}, check 2's two-suffix {77,80}, and eight singleton faults {1,3,7,11,14,73,74,141}. Their symmetric difference is exactly V; qubit 141 cancels. The total cost is 1+1+8=10, not more than 10. The raw order for check 66 is (68,67,78,12,141,72) at times (5,8,9,11,12,32); check 2's last two times are (12,32). The archived verifier checks V∈ker H_Z and V∉rowspace H_X and finds 72 such witnesses in each sector. The effective-distance audit is false; no false completed-root claim is attributed.

archived_witness_excerpt:
`V ∈ ker H_Z`, `V ∉ rowspace(H_X)`, `|V| = 12`, `⊕(residual supports) = V`, and counts the faults
one by one: **144 / 144 assertions pass.** The smallest witness, in full:

```
Z-memory, |V| = 12, 10 faults
  V          = {1, 3, 7, 11, 12, 14, 72, 73, 74, 77, 78, 80}
  hook       check 66, 4-suffix, qubits {78, 12, 141, 72}   times (9, 11, 12, 32)
             (check 66 full CNOT order 68,67,78,12,141,72 at times 5,8,9,11,12,32)
  hook       check  2, 2-suffix, qubits {77, 80}            times (12, 32)
  singletons {1, 3, 7, 11, 14, 73, 74, 141}                 (8 of them)
```

`|V ∩ D| = 5`, `|D \ V| = 1`, so `cost = 2 + (12−5) + 1 = 10`. The X-memory witness has the same
shape (check 18's 4-suffix + check 26's 2-suffix + 8 singletons).
